title: 向林姐报到  (Reporting to Lin Jie at Studio One)

segments.t: Two days before the semifinal taping of Twelve Singers, intern Bu Xiaogu arrives on the busy studio floor to help floor director Lin Jie and her crew. Listen to their conversation first.
林姐，你好，我是布小谷。
节目还有两天才录呢。
怎么现在就缺人手啊？
需要我做些什么吗？
我知道你们总编室的人了不起。
但是我们现场的活也没这么简单。
摄像棚你看到了。
自己找活干吧。
好，我马上过去帮忙。
林姐，小谷干活挺认真的。
好，他们认可了，留下来帮忙吧。
Let's unpack what they say. Xiaogu greets floor director Lin Jie and asks why help is needed so early.
林姐，你好，我是布小谷。
'Lin Jie, hello, I am Bu Xiaogu.' Calling an older female colleague by surname plus "jie", literally 'older sister', sounds warm and respectful on any Chinese workplace team.
节目还有两天才录呢。
'The show does not tape for two more days.' Pairing "haiyou liang tian", 'still two days left', with "cai", 'only then', stresses that taping day feels far off.
怎么现在就缺人手啊？
'How come you are already short of hands right now?' Opening with "zenme" asks 'how come?' in surprise, while "que renshou" literally says 'lack hands' for being understaffed.
需要我做些什么吗？
'Do you need me to do anything?' Reach for "xuyao wo zuo xie shenme ma" whenever you arrive somewhere new and want to offer practical help politely.
我知道你们总编室的人了不起。
'I know you people from the chief editor office are impressive.' At the end, of the line, "liaobuqi" means 'remarkable' or 'impressive', though Lin Jie gives it a dry, teasing edge here.
但是我们现场的活也没这么简单。
'But our work on the studio floor is not that simple either.' Production crews call the live set "xianchang", literally 'the scene on site', and "huo" is the everyday word for 'work' or 'chores'.
摄像棚你看到了。
'You see the studio floor right here.' Putting the topic "shexiangpeng", 'camera studio', right at the front draws attention to the bustling room before saying "ni kandao le", 'you have seen it'.
自己找活干吧。
'Go find work to do on your own.' Starting with "ziji", 'yourself', tells Xiaogu not to wait for orders, and "zhao huo gan" packs 'find tasks to do' into three punchy syllables.
好，我马上过去帮忙。
'Alright, I will head right over to help.' Adding "mashang", literally 'on horseback', means 'right away', and "bangmang" is the everyday chunk for lending a hand.
林姐，小谷干活挺认真的。
'Lin Jie, Xiaogu works pretty earnestly.' Framing "renzheng", 'earnest' or 'conscientious', inside "ting ... de" softens the praise to a natural 'pretty earnest'.
好，他们认可了，留下来帮忙吧。

'Good, they approve, so stay and help out.' Here "renke" means 'recognize' or 'approve of' someone's effort, and "liuxialai" means 'stay behind here'. Now let us hear the whole conversation once more.
林姐，你好，我是布小谷。
节目还有两天才录呢。
怎么现在就缺人手啊？
需要我做些什么吗？
我知道你们总编室的人了不起。
但是我们现场的活也没这么简单。
摄像棚你看到了。
自己找活干吧。
好，我马上过去帮忙。
林姐，小谷干活挺认真的。
好，他们认可了，留下来帮忙吧。

Xiaogu jumps straight into the heavy studio prep without complaining and earns the floor crew's respect. You learned how to offer help with "bangmang", talk about being short-handed with "que renshou", and address a senior woman colleague as "jie". See you next time!
回头见！
